Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
          `-- Reorganize live ownership around CanvasSession, MappingEditorRuntime and the Tldraw Editor. MappingDocumentController still owns semantic commands and checkpoints; attach the new runtime canvas to its explicit MappingEditorRuntime component.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [A] GridBox / LineGridScene
          `-- Add settled native movement and layout writeback; stored GridBox positions remain cell-based.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [C] FloatingBox variants
          `-- Add native shape projection and settled pane geometry without making transient editor geometry authoritative.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Separate live gesture settlement, headless controller edits and buffered agent execution. The former per-call exec path no longer explains the edit boundary.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Show live native undo restoring semantic checkpoint IDs, with domain-history navigation retained when no editor is mounted.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Replace the obsolete sole-writer service with explicit revision operations and retention; distinguish content revisions from controller-owned canvas checkpoints.
  |-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: CanvasSession
          `-- Reorganize membership around coexisting whole-diagram and region items. Captured content-node IDs, not a later rectangle read, define region membership; native shape selection has separate drag ownership.
      `-- [2] Add: Native and application selection ownership
          `-- Develop CanvasSession's Input adapters and GesturePreview components: SelectionGestureController recognizes and cancels pointer gestures, while NativeSelectionOwnership keeps transient drag frames distinct from application selection.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Exec defaults to buffered mutations and compact receipts; immediate mode retains individual commits.
      |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Add canvas.read and turn-bound Agent Chat access under the existing agent interfaces.
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Replace its per-mutation execution contract with queued writes, flush boundaries and retryable batch receipts; retain live and isolated-proposal targets.
      |-- [2] Add: Buffered exec mutations and flush boundaries
          `-- Develop Mapping backend's AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec() component: reads and script completion flush pending writes; an uncertain batch retains its identity for retry.
      `-- [2] Add: Agent Chat canvas binding and current reads
          `-- Develop its live-state and agent-access components: ChatCanvasBindings captures the turn's target and access mode; currentCanvasRead supplies content and revision references without exporting undo history.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
      `-- [1a] Correct: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
          `-- Proposal exec may apply buffered batches instead of committing every mutating call; isolation and acceptance remain separate.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Show the mounted editor settling a gesture into a controller checkpoint before autosave; pointer previews and camera frames do not write history.
  |-- Roll-up 1 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
          `-- Update the retained overview with the live Editor and MappingEditorRuntime ownership boundary.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Replace obsolete UI and per-call agent paths with live settlement, headless commands and buffered execution.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Distinguish live native checkpoint restoration from headless history navigation.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Reflect explicit revision operations and retention rather than the removed sole-writer service.
  |-- Roll-up 2 - g2 - Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
          `-- Update the retained overview with the live Editor and MappingEditorRuntime ownership boundary.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Replace obsolete UI and per-call agent paths with live settlement, headless commands and buffered execution.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Distinguish live native checkpoint restoration from headless history navigation.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Reflect explicit revision operations and retention rather than the removed sole-writer service.
  `-- [3] Tldraw live editor runtime  new canvas
      |-- Runtime ownership and controller boundary
          `-- Detail MappingEditorCanvas, CanvasRuntime and MappingEditorRuntime; connect from MappingPage's explicit MappingEditorRuntime component.
      |-- Shape projection and settled writeback
          `-- Show GridBox, floating pane, edge and side-panel shapes, with native movement committed as domain operations only at settlement.
      |-- Undo and headless fallback
          `-- Show native history carrying checkpoint references and restoring controller state; without a mounted editor, the controller navigates domain history.
      `-- Transient geometry
          `-- Show LocalAnchorStore and NativeRoutingStore as live read models, not persisted geometry owners; connect their projection path to CanvasRuntime.
